Strategy: Leftover-fraction peak: score falls with the distance between the post-placement leftover fraction and one half, so the preferred bin keeps exactly half its space after this item, balancing a tight fill against a reusable remainder regardless of absolute sizes. It can fail when absolute sizes matter more than fractions and half-full bins pile up.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-abs((r - item) / r - 0.5) for r in bins]
```
